name: shop-siren~p2
task: Each time the siren starts ringing, turn it off.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: The clause uses Response(siren_ringing, switch_toggled), which requires a toggle on every step where siren_ringing is true. The task, however, specifies that the agent must turn off the siren only when the siren starts ringing (i.e., at the moment the ring begins). There is no proposition that marks the start of a ring, so the current clause over‑constrains the task by demanding toggles on every ringing step, not just the start. To correctly capture the task, a clause should reference an event that indicates the start of a ring (e.g., a new "siren_start" proposition) or use a different template that triggers only on the transition from not‑rising to rising. Therefore, the current clause is incorrect and must be replaced or removed.

texts: Each time the siren starts ringing, the agent must toggle the siren switch
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES:
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, siren_ringing&!switch_toggled) -> u1
(u1, switch_toggled) -> u0
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, siren_ringing&!switch_toggled, u1) -> -1
(u1, switch_toggled, u0) -> 1
